title: NACA 0021 · Re 270,000 · 30° · IDDES force history
citation: Bidadi, Shreyas, Ganesh Vijayakumar, Ashesh Sharma, and Michael Sprague. 2026. High-Fidelity Simulation Aerodynamics Dataset of NACA 0012 and 0021 Airfoils. NLR Data Catalog. DOI: 10.7799/3014033.
attribution: Source data: DOE/NREL/ALLIANCE (now published by the National Laboratory of the Rockies). No endorsement is implied.

cross_check.comparison: Entire force file is byte-identical, including header and all 6,967 samples.

normalization.method: Same component summation and normalization as the authors plotting script; retain individual time samples rather than the script average of its last 4,000 rows.

time.note: Original solver time is retained. Simulation begins before this stored IDDES segment. Coefficients are not offset to a different recording.

limitations: Force history only: no mesh, flow frames, residuals or pressure field are supplied by this fixture.
Independent Nalu-Wind run; must not be attached to the bundled SU2 recordings.
Geometry has four-chord span; coefficients follow the authors normalization for this run.
